requirement:
Model tool descriptions MUST NOT explain cases the model meets only
occasionally, such as access policy, excluded or build-output paths, redaction,
paging, and failures. The harness MUST explain each of these where it occurs: in
the tool error, or in a note in the result it affects.
rationale:
The requirement has two halves, and both have gaps.

**1. Descriptions must not explain occasional cases.**
- `src/authoring/tools.rs#fn[definitions]` still explains some of the named cases.
  - The `habeas` description says paths are absolute "when permitted by the evidence policy". The `list_files` description says "policy-permitted absolute path". Both explain access policy.
  - The `ripgrep` description spells out "normal ignore rules (including .gitignore and hidden-file exclusions)". That explains which paths are excluded.
  - The `next_page` description explains paging: it says which tools' results come back as a "paged result" and what the token is. A tool needs a description, but the text goes beyond naming the tool, and the requirement says to explain paging in the page note instead.
- The only test, `src/authoring/tools.rs#mod[tests]/fn[descriptions_leave_paging_policy_redaction_and_failures_to_results]`, checks a fixed list of words ("kib", "denied", "habeas.toml" and so on). It does not look for "policy", "paged", "ignore" or "exclusion". So it passes on the descriptions above and does not verify that the MUST NOT holds.

**2. The harness must explain each case where it occurs.**
- Paging is covered. `src/authoring/pages.rs#const[PAGE_NOTE]` is marked {impl}, and `all_pages` asserts the note is present. However, `all_pages` is not marked {test} for this requirement.
- Redaction is covered. `src/authoring/tools.rs#fn[with_redaction_note]` is marked {impl}, and `only_results_with_redacted_text_carry_the_redaction_note` asserts the note. That test is also not marked {test} for this requirement.
- Access policy, build-output paths and read failures are explained in tool errors:
  - the denial messages in `src/authoring/access.rs#impl[SourceAccess]/fn[path]`;
  - the `check_disallow` messages;
  - the "holds build output" and "untracked" messages.
  None of this code carries an {impl} reference to `special_cases`. It carries only `requirements.authoring.read_denial` references, on the Display impls. It cannot be reached from the subject's {impl} items.
- The tests of these errors carry only `read_denial` references, for example `requests_for_book_or_target_output_are_ordinary_read_failures`. Because they were found only by searching, they are gaps under the traceability rules.
- Excluded paths (ignored files, generated evidence) are silently omitted from `list_files` and `ripgrep` results. I found no note or error for them.

No {fixme} acknowledges any of these gaps.

text: :::{req} tool_descriptions.special_cases
Model tool descriptions MUST NOT explain cases the model meets only
occasionally, such as access policy, excluded or build-output paths, redaction,
paging, and failures. The harness MUST explain each of these where it occurs: in
the tool error, or in a note in the result it affects.
:::{req} tool_descriptions.common_case
Each model tool's description MUST give what the model needs in the common
case: what the tool does, when to use it rather than another tool, each
argument's meaning and form, with a short example where the form is not
obvious, and the form of a successful result.
:::{req} result_pages
A result of the `habeas` line-range form, `list_files`, `outline`, `ripgrep`,
`ast_grep`, or `references` whose serialized JSON exceeds 32 KiB MUST be
returned in pages. Each page MUST hold whole entries of the result's arrays, such
as inputs, matches, nodes, or sites, with its accompanying definitions, in the
result's order, and MUST NOT exceed 32 KiB unless a single entry does, which
then forms a page of its own. Every paged result MUST include:
```text
page: {
total_entries: Integer,
returned_entries: Integer,
next: String?,
`next` MUST be an opaque token when entries remain and null on the last page.
While entries remain, the page MUST also include a `note` saying that more
entries remain and that `next_page` with `next` returns them. The
harness MUST expose a `next_page({ token: String })` tool returning the following
page of the same result, in the same shape. Pages MUST be kept only until the
assessment that requested them finishes; an unknown token, including one from
another assessment, MUST return an explanatory tool error. A result within the
limit MUST be returned whole, without `page`. Only inputs on pages delivered to
the model MUST be recorded under {cite}`requirements.authoring.delivered_inputs`.
:::{req} redaction_notice
A tool result containing text the harness redacted under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.redaction` MUST include a note saying that
`[REDACTED:<kind>]` replaces credential-shaped text and that the original is not
available. A result with no redacted text MUST NOT include the note.
